mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.* FROM ( SELECT r.report_sid AS REPORT_SID, r.report_category AS REPORT_CATEGORY, r.report_content AS REPORT_CONTENT, r.reg_id AS REG_ID, r.comment_sid AS COMMENT_SID,
-- [보정 1] 명언 댓글 신고일 경우를 대비해 FAMOUS_SID도 댓글 테이블에서 조회해옵니다. NVL(r.famous_sid, (SELECT c.famous_sid FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.comment_sid = r.comment_sid)) AS FAMOUS_SID,
-- [보정 2] 일기 댓글 신고일 경우를 대비해 DIARY_SID를 확실히 가져옵니다. NVL(r.diary_sid, (SELECT c.diary_sid FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.comment_sid = r.comment_sid)) AS DIARY_SID,
CASE WHEN r.comment_sid IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CAST(c.COMMENT_CONTENT AS VARCHAR2(4000)) FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.comment_sid = r.comment_sid) ELSE TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(d.diary_content, 1, 4000)) END AS DIARY_CONTENT FROM report r LEFT JOIN diary d ON r.diary_sid = d.diary_sid WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY r.report_sid DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize}) ) WHERE rnum > ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r LEFT JOIN diary d ON r.diary_sid = d.diary_sid WHERE 1=1
AND r.report_content LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%' AND r.reg_id LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.* FROM ( SELECT user_id as userId, nickname, admin_chk as adminChk FROM users WHERE 1=1
AND user_id LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%' AND nickname LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%'
ORDER BY user_id ASC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize}) ) WHERE rnum > ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.* FROM ( SELECT diary_sid as diarySid, reg_id as regId, diary_title as diaryTitle, diary_content as diaryContent, diary_status as diaryStatus FROM diary WHERE 1=1
AND diary_title LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%' AND reg_id LIKE '%' || #{searchWord} || '%'
ORDER BY diary_sid DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize}) ) WHERE rnum > ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize})
